master_output.idea:
Core idea: Integrate differentiable feature masking into model training, where learnable parameters dynamically control feature importance weights during gradient descent, enabling the network to automatically identify and prioritize predictive features without manual selection iterations.

Non-trivial crux: Creating a continuous relaxation for discrete feature selection (binary inclusion/exclusion) through sigmoid-constrained masks, allowing gradient-based optimization of feature relevance while preventing gradient leakage through non-differentiable operations via straight-through estimators.
